name: Redundant power-supply decoupling module
summary: A redundancy module decouples documented power-supply inputs before they feed a common load circuit.
description: A redundancy module decouples documented power-supply inputs before they feed a common load circuit. The drawing shows each source input and the combined output so the redundancy arrangement is reviewable.
readingNotes: Check each source's ability to supply the required load under the defined operating condition.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Two parallel supplies alone do not establish the same decoupling function as a redundancy module.
